title: Michael's Article 15, discharge and coded record

tellings.quote: when I left after my article 15, but honorable discharge, honorable discharge, they they said, "We give you honorable discharge."

plain: An Air Force veteran named Michael Johnson says that when he left Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, around 1977 or 1978, he left with an honorable discharge even though he had received an Article 15, a disciplinary punishment handed out by a commander rather than a court. He tells Michels this himself, as part of his own story, remembering that they told him, "We give you honorable discharge." Told this way, the clean discharge after a punishment stands out as an oddity in his service record.
